name: ATM transfer-triggered fee auto-swap manipulation
summary: ATM sold its own token inventory into the ATM/WBNB pair before each non-whitelisted transfer to the pair, sized by that transfer, with no threshold and zero minimum output. A flash-funded attacker repeatedly transferred ATM to the pair and skimmed it back, triggering dozens of protocol dumps, then unwound against the depleted pool.
notes: The deployment fixed the transfer-triggered auto-swap, zero threshold and zero minimum outputs. Later changes (launch(), which only opened trading, the fund address, whitelist entries) gated or sized the exploit without creating the defect.
A second attacker (0xd070490b) repeated the transfer-and-skim loop against the same pair twice within the next 500 blocks; both are campaign.
Loss is the ATM/WBNB pair's WBNB depletion over the three transactions; the ATM it received is not subtracted.
